subject: A user confession that changed everything about Predictify
preview_text: Last week, I got a message that stopped me cold. It wasn't about a prediction. It was about his father.
body_paragraphs: A user named Marco messaged me last Tuesday. He said he almost deleted the app after the first week. Not because it was wrong. Because it was right in a way that hurt.

His dad, a lifelong AC Milan fan, had been fading for months. They'd stopped talking about the games. Last Saturday, Marco opened our derby prediction. Saw the confidence score. Showed his dad. For the first time in months, they argued. Properly. About tactics, not medicine. Marco said our data gave him back 90 minutes of his father. I read that and just sat at my desk.

That's when I realized what we're actually building. It's not just xG and possession stats. It's the language fans use when they've run out of things to say. The tactical analysis feature—the one with the head-to-head history breakdown—that's what Marco used. He said seeing the numbers gave them neutral ground to stand on.

Open the app. Pick a rivalry match this weekend. Go to the head-to-head analysis. Read it. Then share one stat with someone it matters with. That's the whole point. P.S. Marco's dad asked him to explain 'expected goals' yesterday. They're talking again.
